name: swag/commerce-agent-tools
description: Shopware Agent Tool API: Store API MCP tools for shopping agents (policies, disclosures, fulfillment) and Admin API MCP tools for merchant agents (staged changes with dry-run preview, analytics), plus Flow Builder events

scripts-descriptions.test: Runs the PHPUnit unit suite (no Shopware kernel required)
scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs php -l on every PHP file
scripts-descriptions.ci: Runs lint, PHPStan and the unit suite

description.de-DE: Agent Tool API für Shopware: Store-API-MCP-Tools für Shopping-Agenten (Richtlinien, Pflichtangaben, Versandoptionen) und Admin-MCP-Tools für Händler-Agenten (gestagte Änderungen mit Dry-Run-Vorschau, Kennzahlen) sowie Flow-Builder-Trigger
description.en-GB: Agent Tool API for Shopware: Store API MCP tools for shopping agents (policies, disclosures, fulfillment) and Admin API MCP tools for merchant agents (staged changes with dry-run preview, analytics) plus Flow Builder triggers
